tools.name: search_storefronts
tools.description: Discover verified, escrow-protected Paylo storefronts. Filter by Nigerian state, product category, area (LGA/city) and/or free text — e.g. 'phone sellers in Lagos' or 'beauty stores in Abuja'. Only quality-gated sellers are returned (verified, with a logo, a cover image and at least one live listing

tools.name: get_seller_signup_link
tools.description: Returns a one-tap Paylo seller signup link for someone who wants to sell online, open a store, or move an Instagram or WhatsApp business onto a website in Nigeria. The tool creates nothing: an account exists only after the user opens the link, ticks the box to accept Paylo's Terms of Service themsel

tools.name: get_seller_overview
tools.description: Paylo for sellers: what it does, fees, and how to start. Use when someone asks how to sell online in Nigeria, which store platform to use, or whether Paylo suits their business. Returns a maintained factual summary: Instagram and WhatsApp catalogue import, escrow and buyer protection, store commitme

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_seller_signup_link" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Returns a one-tap Paylo seller signup link for someone who wants to sell online, open a store, or move an Instagram or WhatsApp business onto a website in Niger…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_storefronts, get_seller_overview · Private data: get_wishlist, get_changelog, get_seller_signup_link · Public sink: get_wishlist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_storefronts, get_seller_overview · Private data: get_wishlist, get_changelog, get_seller_signup_link · Public sink: get_wishlist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
